title: A simple observation
contentHtml:
The Riemann proof seems like a true surprise.  Yet on the same day Anthropic shares fell about ten percent.  In other words, the market feels that “capabilities” do not necessarily translate into significant social and economic outcomes.

Yet cybersecurity stocks are up considerably over the last few months, due to heightened cyber risk.  So the market is hardly unaware of AI and its potential, when the connection is real and evident.

Just a simple point to ponder.  Here are good comments from Alex Imas and Seb Krier.
